evidence.reason: The finding asserts that recovery_complete (lines 1359, 1366-1369, 1379-1383) reads its expected service bytes/mode/uid/gid and timer state from the journal after recovery has rewritten it, so a self-consistent bug (restore 0600 and also set the snapshot to 0600) would pass. But the journal's snapshot field is the authoritative pre-switch restore reference that recovery consumes; the test compares the actual restored file/timer against that reference, which is the intended oracle. The asserted false pass requires a second, independent bug in which recovery rewrites the very snapshot it restores from, and no supplied source shows recovery modifying the snapshot (only outcome/phase change to rolled_back/restore_activation_pending). That is a test-hardening opportunity, not a demonstrated implementation error in existing intended behavior, so it does not establish a current defect.
